title: Ordnance Survey six-inch to the mile, First Edition: Perth and Clackmannan Sheet CXXXIII (includes Alloa and Alva)
sourceInstitution: National Library of Scotland / Ordnance Survey
rightsStatement: CC BY (National Library of Scotland) for the map service and digitised map images; retain the required NLS attribution.
knownCoverage: Alloa and Alva context. The detailed Alloa town/harbour extent requires the matching First Edition 25-inch sheets, including Clackmannanshire CXXXIX.8 (1863).

sourceReferences.title: National Library of Scotland: Zoom into Clackmannanshire
sourceReferences.notes: Confirms the NLS collection has Alloa-specific historic mapping, including the 1825 town plan and later OS sheets.

sourceReferences.title: Historic Environment Scotland reference to the First Edition six-inch sheet
sourceReferences.notes: Cites Perthshire Sheet CXXXIII, including Alloa and Alva, surveyed 1862 and published 1866.

nextActions: Download the CC BY NLS source sheets for the Alloa town extent and record each catalogue URL, sheet title, survey date and publication date.
Use the six-inch sheet only for regional context; use the 25-inch First Edition sheets for the town, harbour and industrial waterfront.
Record at least six independently checked control points per sheet, spread across the four edges and centre, using stable road junctions, bridges or church towers.
Create a production manifest targeting EPSG:3857 and run the georeferencing validation command before warping or tiling.
Publish only the resulting validated COG/XYZ layer, with National Library of Scotland attribution and the actual sheet dates in the map label.
notes: The current NLS/MapTiler key exposes later seamless overlays but not this First Edition series. This intake therefore prevents a non-working selector entry while documenting the approved route to a high-value, source-backed 1860s overlay.
